why: Landforms. Each row is a process acting on a material in an environment. Gates are axes and flags, not a name regex. Stamps still paint height; this table says what is possible and what a cell is.

forms.name: impact crater
forms.why: A bowl. The background of every old airless surface. Density is a clock; the stamp still takes four numbers.

forms.name: palimpsest
forms.why: A crater that flattened because the ice flowed. Ganymede and Callisto. The proof that ice is a fluid on long timescales.

forms.name: lobate scarp
forms.why: Global contraction of a one-plate lithosphere. Mercury's defining structure; any cooling stagnant lid can have them.

forms.name: wrinkle ridge
forms.why: Compression in a volcanic plain after the lava cooled. Venus and the lunar maria; Mars has them on the ridged plains.

forms.name: patera
forms.why: A volcanic depression, not a cone. Io. Mountains sit beside them, not on them.

forms.name: burial mountain
forms.why: A tilted crustal block pushed up by burial, not a volcano. The highest-relief solid mountains in the Solar System.

forms.name: shield volcano
forms.why: Low-viscosity lava, a long-lived plume. Mars's shields; the same process as a patera with different numbers.

forms.name: lava flow
forms.why: A sheet of recently molten rock. Magma-ocean worlds are this everywhere.

forms.name: chaos terrain
forms.why: A disrupted ice lid over a warmer ocean. Europa. The grammar, not a name match, is what should produce it on any flexed shell.

forms.name: double ridge
forms.why: A pair of ridges with a trough. Diurnal tidal stress on a 3.55-day cycle. Sub-cell at 100 km; the overlay still names it.

forms.name: tiger stripe
forms.why: Parallel fractures venting to space from one hemisphere. Enceladus's south; any ice moon with enough heat can crack there.

forms.name: dune sea
forms.why: Loose grains and a wind. Titan's equator is organic sand; Mars is basalt dust. Sub-cell; cover already shows the grains.

forms.name: methane lake
forms.why: A liquid hydrocarbon basin. Titan's poles. Needs the methane liquid window, which the phase table already computes.

forms.name: karst
forms.why: Dissolution in a soluble rock. Limestone on Earth; labyrinth terrain in Titan's organics-over-ice. Same process, different solvent.

forms.name: layered polar deposit
forms.why: Ice and dust stacked by seasons. Mars's poles; any world with a condensable reservoir can write a climate archive.

forms.name: convection cell
forms.why: Sputnik Planitia. Nitrogen ice soft enough at 40 K to overturn. The substrate table's convectK is the gate.

forms.name: bladed terrain
forms.why: Methane-ice ridges, penitentes at planetary scale. Pluto. Sub-cell; the overlay names a process the heightfield cannot resolve.

forms.name: hollow
forms.why: A shallow pit with a bright halo where a volatile-bearing phase is lost to space. Mercury. A sublimation landform on a world with no air.

forms.name: tessera
forms.why: Old crust that survived a resurfacing. Venus. The engine already skips tesserae in the plains tick.

forms.name: river channel
forms.why: Liquid following the slope. Earth water, Titan methane. The hydro cycle already carries the substance.

forms.name: glacier
forms.why: Ice thick enough to flow. Earth and any cold wet world. Nitrogen convection is a different row.

forms.name: crustal dichotomy
forms.why: A hemispheric elevation split. Mars. Stamp ops place the axis; this row names the form.

forms.name: impact basin
forms.why: A giant bowl. Hellas, Caloris, SPA. Deeper and wider than a ordinary crater.

forms.name: rift canyon
forms.why: A long structural trough. Valles Marineris is the type.

forms.name: corona
forms.why: A circular tectonic welt. Venus. Mantle upwelling, not an impact ring.

forms.name: mare
forms.why: Flood basalt filling a basin. The Moon's nearside. Dark because it is young iron-rich rock.

forms.name: equatorial ridge
forms.why: A spine along the equator. Iapetus. The process is still debated; the placement is measured.

forms.name: chasma
forms.why: A rift in ice. Charon's Serenity chasma; Tethys's Ithaca. Extensional.

forms.name: cryovolcanic dome
forms.why: Ice volcanism. Ceres's Ahuna Mons. The same volcanic grammar in ice.

forms.name: cycloid linea
forms.why: Europa's arcuate cracks. Diurnal tide written in ice.

forms.name: grooved terrain
forms.why: Ganymede's younger bright terrain — fossil ice spreading.

forms.name: dark cratered terrain
forms.why: Ganymede's old dark blocks, torn apart by grooves.

forms.name: cantaloupe terrain
forms.why: Triton's dimpled ice — diapirs rumpling the shell.

forms.name: giant impact basin
forms.why: Mimas's Herschel — a crater a third of the moon.

forms.name: graben
forms.why: Extensional troughs on Ariel and friends.

forms.name: ice cliff
forms.why: Verona Rupes on Miranda — the tallest known cliff.

forms.name: nitrogen basin
forms.why: Pluto's Sputnik Planitia — convecting N₂ ice.
